overview.description: The VegaShares AI Inference ETF (CGPT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund actively manages a narrow portfolio of companies in the AI-inference ecosystem, using the BITA AI Inference Global Index as its primary portfolio-construction baseline. The fund may invest globally across all market caps CGPT was launched on Aug 13, 2026 and is issued by Vegashares.
